Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque
nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous
Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.
Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.
Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto
Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.
Pour en savoir plus:
vie chez nesto
Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.
Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

À propos du poste
En tant que gestionnaire en ingénierie dans le volet IA, vous dirigerez une équipe de développeurs qui conçoit de l'IA appliquée au service de la souscription hypothécaire chez nesto et chez nos partenaires prêteurs. Vous serez responsable de ce que votre équipe livre et des résultats d'affaires qu'elle génère. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipe Produit pour façonner la feuille de route, fixer des objectifs clairs et livrer des solutions robustes en production. Vous recruterez, accompagnerez et ferez grandir une équipe responsable, rapide et fière de son travail.

À propos de l'équipe

Le volet IA développe Maestro, la plateforme hybride de nesto qui combine des règles déterministes et l'IA pour l'intelligence documentaire, la validation et la prise de décision. Notre travail comprend la classification et l'extraction de documents, les règles de validation, les évaluations (evals) et les services d'IA qui les soutiennent. Nous servons les souscripteurs de nesto et des partenaires prêteurs externes, dans une industrie réglementée où la précision et l'auditabilité sont essentielles.

Dès le début, nous avons créé une plateforme technologique moderne et native du cloud (basée sur Google Cloud) respectant les normes les plus élevées de l'industrie en termes de processus de développement et d'exploitation. Notre back-end est écrit en Go et en Python, sous forme de microservices conteneurisés docker bien découplés via des API RESTful et des files d'attente pub-sub. Ces conteneurs sont orchestrés à l'aide de Kubernetes et instrumentés avec Datadog, et notre infrastructure est gérée à l'aide de Pulumi.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Porter les résultats de votre équipe : fixer des objectifs de sprint et de feuille de route avec des jalons d'affaires et des dates, et les livrer
  • Travailler avec l'équipe Produit comme une seule équipe pour prioriser le travail à plus forte valeur et rendre les compromis visibles
  • Livrer des fonctionnalités d'IA appliquée avec les évaluations, garde-fous et suivis nécessaires dans une industrie réglementée
  • Transformer le travail incertain ou exploratoire en objectifs à durée limitée, avec des décisions et des critères d'arrêt clairs
  • Recruter, accompagner et faire grandir les développeurs; donner une rétroaction directe et gérer la sous-performance
  • Bâtir les dossiers de promotion sur les résultats en production, selon les standards de l'entreprise
  • Tenir la direction et les parties prenantes informées des progrès, des risques et des décisions
  • Améliorer la façon de travailler de l'équipe en éliminant les goulots d'étranglement et en adoptant les outils d'IA

Qui nous recherchons

  • 5+ années d'expérience en développement logiciel, dont 2+ années à gérer une équipe de 5 développeurs ou plus
  • Vous avez livré en production des fonctionnalités basées sur l'IA ou les LLM, ou vous apprenez vite et avez livré des systèmes complexes de données ou de ML
  • Vous êtes assez à l'aise avec Python et/ou Go pour réviser des conceptions et du code avec confiance
  • Les résultats d'affaires vous importent plus que la technologie pour elle-même

  • Vous assumez vos échecs et êtes fier(ère) de la croissance de votre équipe
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais requise; le français est un atout important

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici
Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.

  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion
Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.

Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

We are one of the first work-from-anywhere companies with 2,000+ team members utilizing our virtual office called eXp World. This role is work-from-anywhere in the US.

Who is eXp?

Doing the audacious is part of eXp Realty’s DNA. We are a company that rewards creative minds who can offer bold solutions, where opinions matter, anything is possible and the outcome can be revolutionary. As a global full-service real estate brokerage utilizing a 3-D, fully immersive, cloud office environment, offering 24/7 access to collaborative tools & training, eXp has broken the traditional mold of real estate. We are doing big things.Come join us!

What you will do:

Technology at eXp builds the products and platforms that power a cloud-based brokerage serving 80,000+ agents across 29 international markets. With no physical offices, every agent, transaction and piece of data lives on our platform, which makes security and privacy part of the product itself. We're looking for a leader who can protect that platform and the people who rely on it, without slowing down the teams building it.

This role owns the enterprise security and privacy program end to end. You'll set strategy, lead the teams that execute it, and be the accountable leader for cyber risk, incident response, data protection and privacy compliance across the U.S., Canada and our international markets. You'll work closely with AI governance, engineering, Legal and vendor management as we scale AI-enabled tools for our agents.

How you will make an impact:

  • Set security and privacy strategy: define and own the multi-year roadmap, aligned to business and technology priorities, and own the budget behind it.
  • Lead and develop the team: build and grow security engineers, analysts, GRC and privacy professionals, in-house and through partners.
  • Run security operations and incident response: oversee 24/7 monitoring, detection, vulnerability management and threat intelligence; own the incident response plan, tabletop exercises and breach notification process with Legal, Communications and regulators.
  • Embed security in engineering: set standards for secure development, threat modeling, identity and access (SSO, MFA, privileged access) and cloud, endpoint and data platform security.
  • Own the privacy program: manage compliance with applicable laws (including PIPEDA, CCPA/CPRA, other U.S. state laws and GDPR where relevant), privacy impact assessments, data mapping, retention and data subject requests.
  • Manage governance, risk and compliance: maintain the control framework (for example NIST CSF, ISO 27001 or SOC 2), the risk register, policies and standards; run internal and external audits and support SOX requirements with Finance, Legal and Internal Audit.
  • Secure AI and third-party use: partner with AI governance to set security and privacy requirements for AI tools, models and agents; review vendor security and data handling terms, including PII handling and AI usage, before and during every contract.
  • Build awareness: run security and privacy training for employees and 80,000+ independent agents, including phishing simulation.
  • Report on risk: give the CTO, executive team, Audit Committee and Board a clear, business-level view of risk posture and progress.

How you will grab our attention:

  • 10+ years in information security, including 6+ years leading security teams at a large, distributed or cloud-native company.
  • Proven ownership of an enterprise security and privacy program, covering incident response, vulnerability management, identity and cloud security.
  • Working knowledge of privacy law and practice across multiple jurisdictions, including Canadian and U.S. requirements.
  • Experience with at least one major framework (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2) and with external audits.
  • Strong executive and board communication: you explain risk and trade-offs in plain business terms.
  • A track record of partnering with engineering and product teams without slowing delivery.
  • Comfort owning something end-to-end: strategy, build, operation and continuous improvement.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Bonus: public-company experience including SOX-related controls; hands-on experience securing AI and LLM-based systems and agentic workflows; vendor risk experience at enterprise scale; CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/C, CIPP/US or CIPM; experience in real estate, financial services or another regulated, data-rich industry.

If you think you’d make a great match for this position but don’t meet all the requirements, we would still encourage you to apply!

Our Mission

Our mission at Crimson Education is to be the launching pad that equips students globally to compete on the world stage. Crimson's technology, resources, and expertise removes barriers of geography and legacy, seeing its students reach their greatest potential thanks to the dedication of their personalized Crimson teams.

As we expand our team, we are seeking innovative educators who are passionate about helping students earn a place at the right US boarding or day school. Be part of a visionary team committed to making a significant impact on student success.

Our Team

The Boarding & Day School Admissions team brings together strategists and mentors across the US, Asia, Australia, and Europe who believe every student deserves a personalized path to the right school, regardless of where they're coming from. Hailing from top universities worldwide, our mentors bring their own experience of selective admissions to the table as they guide students and families through the boarding and day school process.

What You'll Be Responsible For

You will coach ambitious students across the US, Asia, Australia, and Europe who are applying to competitive US boarding and day schools, in one of two tracks. You'll indicate which track you're applying for. You will report to Head of Operations.

  • Essay Mentor: mentoring students on their application essays, with clear feedback ahead of deadlines

  • Interview Mentor: coaching students to tell their story and present with confidence in their school interviews

  • Both tracks: keeping students and families informed, and partnering with Crimson strategists

What Your Work Entails

Essay track

  • Running formal essay mentoring sessions with students on an ongoing basis, using curriculum knowledge

  • Giving clear, high-quality feedback and strengthening base concepts ahead of essay deadlines

Interview track

  • Helping students articulate their personal story and presentation style

  • Preparing students for video interview formats, including nerves on camera, unscripted follow-up questions and time limits

Both tracks

  • Understanding parents' concerns and partnering through challenging student situations

  • Keeping students and families updated outside formal sessions

What Success Looks Like

  • Students submit strong essays on time, and walk into their interviews prepared and confident

  • Each student's personal story comes through clearly in their essays and interviews

  • Students are supported through to application completion

  • Parents feel heard, and their concerns are handled well

  • Families get clear, timely updates outside sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from a Top 30 US college

  • At least 5-10 hours of availability to mentor each week

  • Passion for education and enjoyment of working with young people; experience mentoring or coaching students is ideal

  • Bilingual Japanese/English and/or Mandarin/English a plus

Essay track

  • US boarding and day school knowledge and admissions experience, including a proven track record of supporting students toward admission

  • Essay mentoring experience

Interview track

  • Direct experience working in an admissions office at a competitive US boarding or day school, including a proven track record of evaluating or supporting students through admissions

  • Interview coaching or student-facing mentoring experience

  • Vericant interview experience strongly preferred: having coached students for, or conducted, Vericant video interviews

Required Skills

  • Admissions expectations at elite boarding and day schools

  • Student story development

  • Clear, specific feedback

  • Warm, engaging coaching of young students

  • Parent partnership

  • Detail orientation and planning

  • Composure under deadline pressure

  • Long-term vision narrowed to short-term strategy

  • Superior written and oral communication.

Time Commitment

  • Hourly contractor role, done remotely

  • Approximately 5-10 hours per week, with flexible scheduling

  • You choose which students to work with

  • Mentors commit to supporting students through to application completion

  • You are paid for live session time, which includes the session plus preparation, session summary and follow-up research

Why Crimson?

  • We're a rapidly growing startup, with a flexible working environment where you will be empowered to structure how you work.

Apply Here!

About EVgo

EVgo (Nasdaq: EVGO) is one of the nation’s largest public fast charging networks for electric vehicles. Our mission is to build a sustainable business that powers our transportation and protects our planet. As a leader in clean transportation, EVgo sits at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and innovation.

We are rapidly expanding our national footprint through strategic partnerships with retailers, automakers, rideshare and, fleets, bringing fast charging to communities across the country. EVgo enables drivers of all makes and models to charge where they want, when they want.

At EVgo, sustainability is not just what we do; it is who we are. We are committed to reducing carbon emissions, advancing clean energy solutions, and building infrastructure that supports a more sustainable future. We believe great companies are built by great people. Our culture is mission driven, customer centric, collaborative, and innovative, with a strong focus on creating an environment where employees can growand make a lasting positive impact. Join us as we charge forward.

Position Summary

The Staff Global Supply Manager owns supplier relationships from sourcing strategy through purchase order execution for key equipment and hardware suppliers, where cost, supply continuity, and day-to-day delivery all matter at once. The role develops sourcing strategies, leads negotiations and supplier performance governance, and manages supply risk. It also issues and tracks purchase orders, maintains the accuracy of item data and transaction records, and provides the data that Finance, Accounting, and Project Management rely on for cash spend and order liability reporting. Working with Engineering, Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Legal, the role gives suppliers one consistent voice from EVgo and keeps material availability aligned with project schedules.

Responsibilities

Sourcing Strategy & Commercial Leadership

  • Develop and own sourcing strategies for high-value, complex, or strategically important categories and supplier relationships.
  • Lead competitive sourcing events and complex negotiations; structure long-term supplier agreements including pricing models, capacity commitments, and performance terms.
  • Drive total cost of ownership analysis, and identify and quantify cost reduction opportunities.
  • Apply knowledge of global supply markets to identify sourcing risks, evaluate alternative supply options, and develop contingency plans, including dual-source plans.
  • Oversee supplier contracts: track terms, keep records audit-ready, and lead amendments and renewals.

Supplier Relationship & Performance Governance

  • Own the full supplier relationship, including executive-level engagements and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
  • Define supplier performance frameworks and scorecards for assigned suppliers, and own the measurement and reporting of vendor fulfillment performance, including fulfillment times, order accuracy, and freight cost.
  • Recommend improvement actions, drive corrective action, and lead supplier development to improve quality, delivery, and innovation.
  • Manage supply disruptions and escalations; develop and run recovery plans with internal and supplier teams.

Procurement & Order Management

  • Monitor project schedules and outbound transactions and issue purchase orders, including to multiple vendors when needed, to replenish stock and support deployment timelines.
  • Own the purchase order lifecycle for assigned suppliers and programs, including changes, receipts, and closure, and ensure orders are approved, coded, and issued on time.
  • Prioritize deliveries based on on-hand availability and planned receipts in coordination with Supply Chain Logistics.
  • Monitor open purchase orders, follow up with suppliers on timely delivery, and resolve delivery issues.
  • Monitor and adjust safety stock levels and reorder points in the ERP system, and own item and SKU profile creation.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources of record to support inventory allocation and procurement recommendations, and provide ERP data as inputs to demand planning.

Cross-Functional Sourcing Partnership

  • Work with Engineering and Product on design-for-cost, manufacturability, and supply readiness; bring sourcing input into NPI early, before commitments are made.
  • Represent sourcing in cross-functional program reviews and help shape build vs. buy and make vs. source decisions.
  • Work with Engineering, Deployment, Operations, and Logistics to align material availability with project schedules.

Finance, Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Partner with Finance, FP&A, and Project Management to model cost scenarios, support capital planning, and build the rolling cash spend outlook for equipment purchase orders.
  • Own the monthly reporting of open, non-cancellable equipment order liabilities and support the inventory reconciliation process with Accounting.
  • Remain accountable for inventory accuracy and SOX compliance pertaining to transaction records in systems of record, including resolving inventory discrepancies.
  • Support Funding and Legal with invoice management, audits, and compliance documentation.
  • Define, document, and continually improve transaction entry processes to reduce error and cost and to improve visibility of critical information for key internal customers.

Team Development & Knowledge Sharing

  • Mentor team members on advanced sourcing, negotiation, supplier management, procurement systems, and documentation standards.
  • Build sourcing playbooks, templates, and best-practice documentation, and contribute to sourcing policy and governance standards.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned to support team and organizational objectives.

Qualifications

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience

Desired Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Operations, Logistics, or a related field; Master's or MBA preferred.
  • Equivalent technical education or training in a related field (e.g., certification program, coursework in supply chain, procurement, engineering, or business, or demonstrated on-the-job learning) accepted in lieu of a formal degree.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-value sourcing events and negotiations independently.
  • Deep expertise in supplier relationship management, performance governance, and contract structuring.
  • Strong analytical skills, including TCO modeling, spend analytics, and cost benchmarking, and proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Working knowledge of ERP systems and the ability to work across ERP and CRM systems and multiple communication channels.
  • Working knowledge of inventory management and logistics processes.
  • Working knowledge of internal controls for transaction records, including SOX requirements.
  • Proven ability to partner with engineering or technical teams on hardware sourcing and NPI processes.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Flexibility for occasional evening calls with international vendors.
  • Up to 20% travel may be required for supplier visits, warehouse and site visits, executive engagements, and team meetings.
  • APICS CSCP, ISM CPSM, or equivalent professional certification.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics, and procurement systems such as Coupa or Ariba.
  • Experience with global supply chains, including Asia-based ODM and CM ecosystems.
  • Background in EV infrastructure, power electronics, industrial equipment, technology hardware, or infrastructure deployment supply chains.

Benefits and Perks

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus mental wellbeing support and wellness programs
  • Financial Benefits: 401(k), Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, life and disability insurance
  • Work-Life Support: Uncapped paid time off, enhanced parental leave, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Care Navigation & Support: Access to Health Advocate services for help with claims, provider searches, and care decisions
  • Flexible Care Options: Telehealth services for convenient, low-cost access to care
  • Growth & Development: Mentorship programs and opportunities for career growth and internal mobility
  • Additional Perks: Monthly Tech Stipend, one-time home office setup reimbursement, Volunteer time off, commuter benefits, and employee focused programs

  • Master's degree.
  • Familiarity with Medicare Advantage, including Stars and Risk Adjustment.
  • Familiarity with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and telemedicine industry trends is a plus.


Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$104,000 - $143,000 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 01-18-2027


About us

About CenterWell Senior Primary Care: CenterWell Senior Primary Care provides proactive, preventive care to seniors, including wellness visits, physical exams, chronic condition management, screenings, minor injury treatment and more. Our unique care model focuses on personalized experiences, taking time to listen, learn and address the factors that impact patient well-being. Our integrated care teams, which include physicians, nurses, behavioral health specialists and more, spend up to 50 percent more time with patients, providing compassionate, personalized care that brings better health outcomes. We go beyond physical health by also addressing other factors that can impact a patient’s well-being.About CenterWell, a Humana company: CenterWell is a leading healthcare services business focused on creating integrated and differentiated experiences that put our patients at the center of everything we do. The result is high-quality healthcare that is accessible, comprehensive and, most of all, personalized. As the largest provider of senior-focused primary care, a leading provider of home healthcare and a leading integrated home delivery, specialty, hospice and retail pharmacy, CenterWell is focused on whole health and addressing the physical, emotional and social wellness of our patients. CenterWell is part of Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM). Learn more about what we offer at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Boston Government Services, LLC. (BGS) is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst / Documentation Lead to support our clients.

BGS is an engineering, technology, and security firm helping to advance missions of national importance for government programs, national laboratories, national security facilities, nuclear operations, and complex projects. We support clients at every stage, from strategic planning and program management to the execution of engineering and technical activities. We work to attract and retain the best talent because the best talent delivers the best results for our clients. Our capabilities are based on our experience in complex, secure, and highly regulated environments. We leverage our experience and capabilities to provide mission-driven solutions tuned to our client's mission needs and strategic direction.

Work that Matters. People that Matter More.At BGS, we believe meaningful work starts with great people. We foster a culture built on respect, collaboration, and accountability—where employees are empowered to contribute ideas, grow professionally, and make an impact. We care about our employees’ well-being through competitive benefits, clear expectations, and an environment that values both excellence and connection.

If you align with BGS’ company values and culture, we would love for you to explore opportunities to join our growing team by checking out the job description below!

BGS is seeking an experienced Senior Cybersecurity Analyst / Documentation Lead to oversee cybersecurity documentation development, governance, and document control activities supporting federal and critical infrastructure cybersecurity programs. This role serves as the lead for documentation development efforts across cybersecurity policies, plans, procedures, records, and authorization artifacts while ensuring consistency, traceability, and compliance with regulatory and industry standards.

The successful candidate will provide leadership for documentation teams, manage document production workflows, support continuous monitoring activities, and serve as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) supporting ongoing cybersecurity operations and compliance efforts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cybersecurity governance documentation, including policies, plans, procedures, standards, and operational records.
  • Manage teams responsible for producing compliance documentation and security artifacts supporting cybersecurity assessment and authorization activities.
  • Develop documentation supporting NIST SP 800-53 control families, including but not limited to:
    • Audit and Accountability (AU)
    • Identification and Authentication (IA)
    • Incident Response (IR)
    • Physical and Environmental Protection (PE)
    • Personnel Security (PS)
    • System and Services Acquisition (SA)
    • Supply Chain Risk Management (SR)
    • Privacy controls and supporting documentation, as required
  • Establish and maintain document control processes, including:
    • Document templates
    • Numbering conventions
    • Revision management
    • Version control
    • Approval workflows
    • Configuration management practices
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, traceability, and quality across all cybersecurity documentation deliverables.
  • Manage document production schedules, review cycles, stakeholder comments, and final turnover packages.
  • Coordinate document reviews and approvals with technical teams, management, and customer stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain compliance matrices and cross-references between regulatory requirements, security controls, and supporting documentation.
  • Support cybersecurity assessments, audits, and authorization activities through documentation development and evidence preparation.
  • Serve as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) supporting:
    • Continuous monitoring activities
    • Security impact analysis
    • Risk management activities
    • POA&M management and tracking
    • Ongoing compliance oversight
  • Plan, coordinate, and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises, including incident response and contingency planning exercises.
  • Develop exercise documentation, after-action reports, lessons learned, and improvement plans.
  • Support cybersecurity awareness and training initiatives through the development of user guides, training materials, and supporting documentation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of experience in cybersecurity governance, compliance, risk management, or cybersecurity program support.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining cybersecurity policies, plans, procedures, standards, and operational records across NIST SP 800-53 control families.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity governance frameworks and compliance requirements.
  • Extensive experience with technical writing and documentation management.
  • Demonstrated expertise in:
    • Document control processes
    • Revision history management
    • Controlled numbering systems
    • Configuration management practices
    • Approval and review workflows
    • Quality assurance for technical documentation
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) programs and authorization activities.
  • Experience serving as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or supporting ISSO functions.
  • Experience supporting:
    • Continuous monitoring programs
    • POA&M development and management
    • Security impact analyses
    • Compliance reporting and tracking
  • Experience planning and facilitating cybersecurity, incident response, and contingency planning tabletop exercises.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable documentation.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
  • Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC).
  • Experience supporting Department of Energy (DOE), Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), utility, or other highly regulated critical infrastructure environments.
  • Experience supporting federal cybersecurity assessment and authorization programs.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity awareness and training materials.
  • Experience working within energy, industrial, operational technology (OT), or critical infrastructure sectors.

Location/Work Arrangement:

  • Schedule is full-time, Monday – Friday 40-hour week.
  • This position is Remote.

Benefits:

BGS offers a competitive total compensation package to eligible employees. Benefits include Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Paid Vacation, 401K, Long and Short-Term Disability.

EEO:

BGS is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Exclusive Agreement Disclaimer:

BGS has standing contracts with federal agencies throughout the United States. We require an affirmative exclusive agreement to represent all candidates to our clients. By submitting this application, you are consenting to allow BGS to represent you as a candidate for the role in which you are applying.


Schedule is full-time, Monday – Friday 40-hour week.
This position is Remote.

      <title>Knock: Lending Manager (Front End) - Remote</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! We’re a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of<em> Inc.’s Best Workplaces</em> six times in the past seven years.</p>
<p>We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.&nbsp; The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit <a href="http://knock.com/">Knock.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Lending Manager (Front End)</strong></p>
<p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p><strong>Knock is looking for an experienced mortgage leader to manage and grow our team of fully remote Loan Assistants. This is a 100% remote role, and you’ll lead a team distributed across the country. You enjoy building teams, finding efficiencies, and using technology to improve how work gets done. You’re approachable, open-minded, and adaptable. You know the work well enough to coach it and you’re willing to jump in and help. In this role you’ll own the Loan Assistant and post-closing pipelines, develop your team, and work with the Director of Lending Operations to make our processes better.</strong></p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Lead and develop the team</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Manage, lead, and scale the remote Loan Assistant team. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Share weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual team and company goals, and make sure the team meets and exceeds expectations.Hold team members accountable for their performance.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Build camaraderie and teamwork in a virtual environment through team meetings and regular 1:1 check-ins.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Run virtual training for new Loan Assistants and serve as the team’s go-to for escalations, questions, and exceptions.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Mentor people inside and outside your team, and keep learning yourself.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Document conversations in our HRIS and build a sense of ownership across the team.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Own the pipeline</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Manage the bridge loan pipeline from setup through initial disclosure and submission, and through post-closing. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Coach the team and give feedback along the way.Balance workloads across the team to meet company SLAs.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Support post-closing review. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Work loans that have findings with the team member responsible and get them resolved.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Work closely with Sales, Underwriting, and Closing to give everyone timely, accurate service.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Compile team scorecard data each quarter to track KPIs and quality.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Improve how we work</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Help the Director of Lending Operations find gaps in process and policy across the Loan Assistant and post-closing functions. </strong></li>
<li><strong>Write or update procedures for review, training, and rollout, then follow up to make sure the changes stick.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Set best practices and change the workflow when needed so the team runs efficiently and meets company KPIs.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Take on ad hoc projects and step in wherever your team needs support.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>At least 10 years of relevant mortgage experience, including 5 or more years directly managing a fully remote team</strong></li>
<li><strong>Experience managing mortgage loan processing and/or post-closing teams</strong></li>
<li><strong>A track record of coaching teams and helping them succeed</strong></li>
<li><strong>Working knowledge of federal, state, and local mortgage regulatory compliance</strong></li>
<li><strong>Strong written and virtual communication skills</strong></li>
<li><strong>You keep a distributed team aligned, engaged, and accountable using tools like Slack and video meetings</strong></li>
<li><strong>A strong focus on customer service. You go above and beyond to “wow” the people you serve.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Close attention to detail. You check your work carefully and catch the small things, so your work is consistently accurate.</strong></li>
<li><strong>A commitment to diverse, equitable, and inclusive practices that support Knock’s values of making an impact, learning, putting people first, being open, and being courageous</strong></li>
<li><strong>High school diploma or equivalent experience</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Physical Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Set up and constantly operate a computer</strong></li>
<li><strong>Communicate and exchange accurate information to others via telephone or internet video applications</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated.&nbsp; Please note that the salary range information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act for Colorado applicants. </strong></p>
<p><strong>The salary range estimate for this position is: $90,000 - $100,000 + company incentive plan (bonus) USD. </strong></p>
<p><strong>This job opening expires December 31, 2026.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="section page-centered">
<div class="content-wrapper posting-page">
<div class="content">
<div class="section-wrapper page-full-width">
<div class="section page-centered">
<p><strong> Offer &amp; Employment Terms</strong></p>
<p>The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package &amp; benefits, will be at the company’s sole discretion, and determined by factors including but not limited to years of experience, job level, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. The company also reserves the right to amend or modify this job description, employee perks, and benefits at any time. Employees eligible for bonus and/or commission will be provided details in the offer letter.</p>
<p><strong></strong><strong>Why Knock</strong></p>
<p> Purpose-Driven Work: Your contributions will improve the homeownership journey for thousands of individuals and families.<br> Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S. with a flexible, people-first approach.<br> Innovative Culture: Collaborate with curious, talented colleagues in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. To learn more about the culture at Knock, view our <a href="https://a-us.storyblok.com/f/1005183/x/a6121f1519/knock_culture_popsicle.pdf">POPSICLE values</a>.<br> Commitment to Inclusion: We are dedicated to creating diverse teams and an inclusive, respectful culture where everyone belongs.</p>
<p><strong> Enjoying Life &amp; Making an Impact</strong></p>
<p> Since our founding in 2015, Knock has and continues to offer a <strong>100% remote work culture<br></strong> Top tier medical, dental, &amp; vision benefits for full time employees starting on the first day of employment<br> Flexible Paid Time Off for full time employees<br> Paid parental leave for all full time employees:<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; - 12 weeks paid parental leave for the birthing parent<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; - 6 weeks paid parental leave for the non-birthing parent<br> One thousand annually for professional development<br>️ Life, AD&amp;D and Disability insurance for full time employees<br> 401K (noncontributory by Knock) for all employees<br> $75 monthly allowance for health &amp; wellness<br> Up to $400 monthly for a co-working space for eligible employees<br> $100 monthly allowance for home internet, mobile phone or other communication devices<br> $2,500 referral bonus for eligible employees</p>
<p><strong>️ Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></p>
<p>Knock provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable US federal, state, or local laws.</p>
<p><strong> Internal Applicants</strong></p>
<p>If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles.</p>
<p><strong> Remote Culture &amp; Company Mission</strong></p>
<p>We are proud to be a remote, distributed company with employees across 17 states and counting. This is an amazing opportunity to be an integral part of building a multi-billion dollar consumer brand in an industry that is long overdue for a new way of doing things. You will be working with a passionate team that is disrupting the status quo.</p>
<p>Knock, and its subsidiaries, are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable US federal, state, or local laws.</p>
<p><strong> Recruiter Policy</strong></p>
<p>Please no recruitment firm or agency inquiries — you will not receive a reply from us.</p>
<p><strong> Application Tip</strong></p>
<p>PDF is our preferred format for resumes and any other attachments. Thank you!</p>
<p><strong>#LI-Remote</strong></p>
<p><br><br></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knock-lending-manager-front-end-remote">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knock-lending-manager-front-end-remote</a></p>
</description>

      <title>ZoomInfo Technologies LLC: Principal Product Management, Growth</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.</p></div><h1>Principal Product Manager, Growth</h1>
<h2>About ZoomInfo</h2>
<p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute — you'll make things happen, fast.</p>
<h2>The Opportunity</h2>
<h3>Own a Growth Portfolio and Set the Pattern the Rest of the Team Inherits</h3>
<p>ZoomInfo built the industry's most sophisticated GTM data platform. The next frontier is turning every visitor into revenue without waiting on a human handoff — a coherent self-serve journey that activates a non-customer in minutes, converts consumption into upgrade, and routes high-intent signals back to sales when a human will close more than they distract.</p>
<p>You'll define the multi-quarter thesis on which channels compound, the operating rhythm the rest of the growth PM team inherits, and the ZoomInfo POV on how buyers discover us in an AI-first world.</p>
<p>The impact is immediate and compounding. Every signup you activate, every credit you cause to be consumed, every transaction, every PQL you route, every "buy more" event you trigger is revenue — and every operating pattern you set multiplies across the growth PM group. We've adopted a consumption-first monetization model and a unified entry-point thesis across the company, and we run weekly: if your hypothesis can't be falsified inside a sprint, it isn't a hypothesis. This is a rare opportunity to own a P&amp;L-shaped surface with full air cover to ship fast, learn in public, re-pivot when the data turns — and to define the growth PM craft as ZoomInfo scales it.</p>
<h2>What You'll Do</h2>
<h3>Own the Portfolio End-to-End</h3>
<p>Take a portfolio-scope growth surface — and own it from first impression to revenue. Define the entry points, the activation milestones, the monetization moments, and the sales-assist signals across the channels that make up the portfolio. Drive the user experience across surfaces: landing, signup, in-product onboarding, empty states, upgrade modals, paywalls, lifecycle communication, and the agent-readable / LLM-discovery surfaces that are becoming primary. You own the funnel chart; you own the why behind every drop.</p>
<h3>Set the Multi-Quarter Growth Thesis</h3>
<p>Beyond weekly experiments, own 4-8 quarter bets on which channels compound and which retire. Publish a written POV on where PLG distribution is heading (LLM-first discovery, MCP-as-channel, agent-readable onboarding, partner-driven trials) and defend the sequencing to the exec team. Rebalance investment across the portfolio quarterly based on unit economics, not the loudest channel.</p>
<h3>Run Experimentation as the Operating Rhythm — and Set the Rhythm for the Team</h3>
<p>Ship 8-10 experiments per sprint. Pre-register the hypothesis, the metric, the success threshold, and — critically — the invalidation signal. Read results weekly, kill what doesn't work, double down on what does, and keep a written record so the team compounds learning instead of repeating it. Your rubric, your retro format, and your invalidation-signal standard become the template the rest of the Growth PM group inherits. Translate results into concrete changes: copy rewrites, schema tweaks, pricing changes, new flows, retired ones. Close the loop with engineering, design, and analytics inside the same week.</p>
<h3>Design Self-Serve as a First-Class Path</h3>
<p>Most users on your portfolio never speak to sales before they hit a "buy more" moment. Your in-product copy, paywall framing, empty states, activation paths, and upgrade triggers are the product. Apply growth-engineering rigor — credit economics, consumption pacing, signal routing, lifecycle messaging, intelligent gating — so the right offer lands in front of the right user at exactly the right moment. Hand high-intent users to sales with a clean signal; absorb low-intent users with a clean self-serve path.</p>
<h3>Diagnose the Funnel With Data, Not Vibes</h3>
<p>Data is your default tool, not a thing you ask analytics to do for you. You independently analyze the funnel, segment the cohort, find the leak, and propose the fix — then validate it with an experiment. You know when to trust a 5% lift and when to call it noise. Just as important: you know when to zoom out from a specific funnel drop to a portfolio-level rebalance, and can defend that call.</p>
<h3>Shape the Monetization Mechanic</h3>
<p>You'll design the credit economics of your portfolio: what's free, what's gated, what gets a "buy more" prompt, what triggers a PQL. You'll model the unit economics — credit cost, revenue per credit, upgrade rate, expansion rate — and you'll defend the pricing decisions in front of finance and sales leadership with the math.</p>
<h3>Orchestrate Across Sales, Marketing, and CS</h3>
<p>Self-serve doesn't mean alone. You'll route PQLs into the right hands (AE, SC, AM, or no one), partner with marketing on acquisition and lifecycle, and work with CS to understand why activated users churn before upgrade. You'll run the operating cadences that keep your portfolio aligned with the broader PLG portfolio without becoming a meeting machine.</p>
<h3>Multiply the Team</h3>
<p>Help hire and calibrate the Sr Growth PMs owning adjacent loops. Coach them into ownership. Your retro is their template; your experiment quality is their bar. Raise the craft of the whole Growth PM group as it scales.</p>
<h3>Stay Honest About What's Working</h3>
<p>Write retrospectives that name the wrong calls as cleanly as the right ones. Update your priors publicly when the data turns. Hold strong opinions weakly. The team that ships the most experiments isn't the team that's right the most — it's the team that updates the fastest.</p>
<h2>What You'll Bring</h2>
<ul>
<li>8–12 years of product management experience, with 4+ years specifically in growth, PLG, or self-serve product roles</li>
<li>Direct P&amp;L ownership at portfolio scope — a loop or portfolio you've driven from &lt;$X to &gt;$Y with your name on the number, not a feature inside someone else's loop</li>
<li>Experience presenting to CEO / CRO / CFO / board on growth mechanics — the credit-economics deck, the funnel narrative, the "kill this bet" moment</li>
<li>Track record of hiring, mentoring, or calibrating other growth PMs — comfortable being the bar</li>
<li>You're a builder. You ship landing pages, signup flows, and in-product experiments — not specs that sit in Jira. You sit with designers and engineers, write copy, and prototype with code.</li>
<li>AI-fluent with a public POV. You understand that LLMs are becoming a primary discovery surface. You have opinions — publishable ones — about agent-readable flows, MCP-as-distribution, GEO/AEO, and how an AI agent's recommendation impacts a funnel.</li>
<li>Marketing-fluent. You hold your own with SEO, paid acquisition, content, and lifecycle marketing teams as a peer, not a consumer.</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of running structured experimentation (A/B tests, multivariate, holdouts, pre/post) at sprint cadence — including at cohort sizes where 50/50 doesn't have power</li>
<li>Strong analytics fluency — comfortable in Snowflake without analyst hand-holding</li>
<li>Working knowledge of consumption-based pricing, credit economics, freemium mechanics, and PQL frameworks</li>
<li>B2B SaaS background; data, GTM, or sales-tech domain experience is a plus but not required</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who You Are</h2>
<h3>Core Competencies</h3>
<p>Funnel Foundation. Expert-level understanding of full-funnel growth. You can reason about activation rates, time-to-value, retention curves, credit economics, upgrade triggers, and PQL signal quality with depth. You've owned a growth loop — or portfolio — in production. SQL and analytics fluency let you diagnose a funnel drop, prototype the fix, and validate it in the same week.</p>
<p>Portfolio Thinking. You reason about ToF (or an equivalent surface) as a portfolio of channels with different unit economics, decay curves, and compounding dynamics — not a single funnel. You rebalance investment quarterly based on where marginal dollars return the most, and you can defend the rebalance to leadership with the math.</p>
<p>Experimentation Discipline. You don't ship without a hypothesis. You pre-register the metric and the invalidation signal before the test runs. You read results honestly, kill losing variants without ego, and document learnings so the team compounds knowledge instead of relitigating settled questions. You know the difference between an experiment and a launch — and you can tell when each is the right move.</p>
<p>Category POV. You have a public, defensible point of view on where PLG distribution is heading — agent-readable surfaces, MCP-as-channel, GEO/AEO, LLM-first onboarding — grounded in benchmarks from peer companies (Clay, Linear, Vercel, Cursor, Notion), not just internal data. That POV shows up in the roadmap.</p>
<p>Distribution Mindset. Experience designing growth surfaces where sales teams, marketing teams, and self-serve users are simultaneously your customers. You measure success through revenue, consumption, and expansion velocity, not screens shipped. You understand growth economics: each additional entry point, freemium offer, or AI trial compounds in value through shared activation patterns, amortized acquisition costs, and recurring consumption network effects.</p>
<p>Operational Velocity. You read the funnel daily, not quarterly. You prototype emerging mechanics — paywalls, in-app prompts, lifecycle sequences — to understand their practical constraints before committing engineering time. You hold strong opinions weakly, updating your design assumptions as evidence accumulates, publicly, even when the prior thesis was your own.</p>
<p>Strategic Communication. You translate between funnel depth and business impact fluently. You can explain to the CEO why a credit pricing change is worth a quarter of work. You can communicate to engineers why a revenue constraint requires a "quiet release" in two weeks rather than a polished launch in three months. You influence without formal authority through forcing functions, falsifiable invalidation signals, and earned credibility.</p>
<p>Talent Leverage. You coach Sr PMs into full ownership of their loops. Your retro is their template. Your experiment quality is their bar. You help hire the next PMs on the team, and you calibrate — you know what "great" looks like at Sr level and you can articulate the gap to someone who isn't there yet.</p>
<p>Copy Instinct. Microcopy is part of your craft, not someone else's job. You can rewrite a paywall headline, an upgrade modal, an empty state, or an onboarding CTA on instinct — and defend the rewrite with PLG principles. You know when to ask content design for help and when to ship the rewrite yourself.</p>
<h2>The Environment</h2>
<h3>Reporting, Pace &amp; Impact</h3>
<p>Reporting &amp; Collaboration. Report to the VP Product, PLG. Peer to the Sr Directors of Marketing, Sales Operations, and Customer Success on the growth contracts (PQL routing, demand-gen alignment, credit economics). Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the engineering and design leaders building the underlying surfaces, the GTM leaders routing PQLs into sales, and a peer PM group covering monetization, lifecycle, viral, onboarding, and analytics. Regular exposure to the CEO, CRO, CMO, and CFO — you own those conversations at your level.</p>
<p>Pace &amp; Problems. Fast-moving teams that understand the space. Weekly experimentation cadence layered under 4-quarter portfolio bets. Expect interesting problems: How do we win activation in a user's first 60 seconds? When should two trial flows become one? How do we expose enough value to convert without giving away the platform? How do we price a credit so that customers consume more, not less? When should a self-serve user be routed to sales — and when does that routing actually destroy revenue? How do buyers discover ZoomInfo when discovery goes through Claude and ChatGPT? Your decisions become operating patterns across the PLG organization.</p>
<p>Impact. Own a portfolio-scope growth surface at a company that is already AI-first in product thinking and consumption-first in monetization. Your decisions compound. Every improvement to the funnel, the offer, or the activation experience multiplies across multiple products, every partner-driven self-serve channel ZoomInfo ships into, and every AI distribution surface we haven't yet imagined — and every operating pattern you set makes the next PM on the team better.</p>
<p>What changed at a glance:</p>
<ul>
<li>Title + opening reframed from loop-scope → portfolio-scope, ToF-leaning but flexible</li>
<li>Three new sections in What You'll Do: Set the Multi-Quarter Thesis, Represent PLG to Leadership, Multiply the Team</li>
<li>Seniority bar: 4-7 yrs → 8-12 yrs; adds direct P&amp;L ownership, exec/board presenting, hiring/mentoring</li>
<li>Two new competencies: Portfolio Thinking, Category POV, Talent Leverage</li>
<li>Reporting line: Sr Director → VP Product, PLG; peer to CRO/CMO/CFO direct reports</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.</p>
<p>In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits <a class="c-link" href="https://www.zoominfo.com/careers#benefits">here</a>.</p></div><div class="title">Below is the US base salary for this position.       <title>Oportun: Senior ML Engineer (R14284)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - India 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><span>Who We Are</span></h2>
<p><span>Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.</span></p></div><h2><span><span>A Quick Note on the Role's Focus</span></span></h2>
<p>While the title is <strong>Senior ML Engineer</strong>, this opportunity is specifically focused on <strong>ML Platform Engineering </strong>rather than<strong> </strong>ML model development or data science.</p>
<p>We're looking for engineers with strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building, scaling, and operating the platforms and infrastructure that enable machine learning in production. The emphasis is on <strong>ML infrastructure, MLOps, model serving, platform reliability, and production engineering</strong>, rather than primarily developing, training, or fine-tuning ML models.</p>
<h2><span><span><br>Location Note</span></span></h2>
<p><span>We’re excited to consider talent currently based in India, as well as candidates who are open to relocating to India for this opportunity. Please note that, as this is a "Remote–India" position, <strong>the role must be performed from within India.</strong></span></p>
<h2><span><br>The Opportunity</span></h2>
<p><span>The <strong>Machine Learning Platform</strong> team builds the software foundations that enable data scientists and machine learning engineers to develop, validate, deploy, and operate models safely and efficiently in production. In this role, you’ll lead complex platform work from business context through production outcomes, combining hands-on engineering, architectural judgment, production ownership, and mentorship. In your first year, success means leading meaningful platform initiatives, improving reliability and developer experience, and becoming a trusted technical leader for the ML platform.</span></p>
<h2><span>At Oportun, we move fast and hold each other to a high bar. You’ll partner across Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering to solve ambiguous problems and move the needle for members and the business.<br><br></span></h2>
<h2><span>What You'll Do</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Your day-to-day</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll lead the design, implementation, deployment, and operation of complex platform capabilities that support the machine-learning lifecycle.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll design scalable systems for model deployment and serving, feature computation, data validation, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and production support.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll build reusable platform components, standards, and automation while improving reliability, scalability, observability, and operational readiness across ML systems.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll partner with Data Science, Product, Risk, Fraud, and Engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical solutions.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll own significant technical initiatives end to end and lead complex production investigations—clarifying requirements, leading design, delivering safely, measuring results, and implementing durable fixes.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll raise engineering quality through thoughtful code and design reviews, mentor engineers through pairing and technical guidance, and contribute to platform technical strategy.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Who You Are</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>The right fit looks like this</strong></span></p>
<p><span>You do not need detailed implementation direction to be effective. Given an ambiguous problem and sufficient context, you can define the technical approach, explain trade-offs, align stakeholders, lead delivery, and own the outcome after launch.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>You’re comfortable navigating complexity and don’t wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, mentor others, and connect engineering work to member, business, and operational outcomes.</strong></span></p>
<h2><span>What You Bring</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Skills &amp; experience</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll have 5+ years of professional software-engineering experience building and operating production systems, with strong programming skills in Python and deep knowledge of API design, distributed systems, service architecture, testing, and software-design fundamentals.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ve demonstrated experience designing and operating reliable, scalable cloud-native services or data-intensive systems, with experience in ML platforms, model serving, feature engineering, data platforms, MLOps, or related systems.</span></li>
<li><span>You bring practical experience with SQL, databases, caching, and tracing data or requests across multiple systems, plus familiarity with the ML lifecycle from feature engineering and model training through evaluation, deployment, serving, monitoring, and governance.</span></li>
<li><span>You have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git-based workflows, and production observability, and you can evaluate technical alternatives and clearly communicate recommendations, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ve demonstrated the ability to mentor engineers, improve engineering practices, lead through technical influence, and connect engineering work to member, business, product, and operational outcomes.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Experience with AWS, Databricks, MLflow, SageMaker, Spark/PySpark, Kafka, or streaming systems.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience building feature platforms, model-serving systems, workflow-orchestration platforms, or internal developer platforms.</span></li>
<li><span>Familiarity with monitoring model quality, data quality, feature coverage, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency, and experience working with sensitive data in a regulated or financial-services environment.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with Java or another backend language in addition to Python, and familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve personal productivity.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Our AI Mindset</span></h2>
<p><span><strong><span>We b</span>uild with AI. We lead with judgment.</strong></span></p>
<p><span>AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.</span></p>
<p><span>We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be <span><strong>open to experimenting</strong></span>, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.</span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when <span><strong>human judgment and AI capability work together</strong>.</span></span></p>
<h2><span>Why Oportun</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>What's in it for you</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.</span></p>
<p><span>Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:</span></p>
<p><span><strong>India Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Medical, Dental &amp; Vision Insurance</span></p>
<p><span>Provident Fund</span></p>
<p><span>Life &amp; Accident Insurance</span></p>
<p><span>Internet, Fuel, Meal &amp; Telephone Allowances</span></p>
<p><span>Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit <span><strong>oportun.com/careers&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp; <span>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1</span></span></span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>&nbsp;</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:&nbsp; <a href="https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/">https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/</a>.</span></em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em><span>We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).</span></em></p></div>
